title: Zero Lelong numbers for minimal metrics on nef adjoints
exact_target: For a normal connected projective complex klt pair $(H,\Theta )$ with effective rational $\Theta $ and nef Q-Cartier $D=K_H+\Theta $, does every semipositive singular Hermitian metric with minimal singularities on $\pi *D$ have zero Lelong number at every point, for every projective log resolution $\pi :V\to H$? Existence of such a minimal metric is included; $K_H$ and $\Theta $ need not separately be Q-Cartier.
definition_tex:
\subsection{Definitions and mathematical statement}
\paragraph{Statement recorded in the supplied source.}
For a normal connected projective complex klt pair $(H,\Theta )$ with effective rational $\Theta $ and nef Q-Cartier $D=K_H+\Theta $, does every semipositive singular Hermitian metric with minimal singularities on $\pi *D$ have zero Lelong number at every point, for every projective log resolution $\pi :V\to H$? Existence of such a minimal metric is included; $K_H$ and $\Theta $ need not separately be Q-Cartier.

\subsection{Short English statement}
For a normal connected projective complex klt pair $(H,\Theta )$ with effective rational $\Theta $ and nef Q-Cartier $D=K_H+\Theta $, does every semipositive singular Hermitian metric with minimal singularities on $\pi *D$ have zero Lelong number at every point, for every projective log resolution $\pi :V\to H$? Existence of such a minimal metric is included; $K_H$ and $\Theta $ need not separately be Q-Cartier.
